# Content Editor Provenance Panel

> Source: `specs/workbench/2.3-content-editor-provenance.md`
> Parent: `knowledge-ops-workbench-ux-breakdown.md`
> Points: 1

**Parent**: `knowledge-ops-workbench-ux-breakdown.md`
**Epic**: 2. Content Editor View
**Points**: 1
**Dependencies**: 2.1 Content Editor Shell, P1B (graph memory for provenance data)

## Purpose

Right panel showing sources, agent contributions, and corrections that shaped the document.

## Scope

Breakdown 2026-05-29: Code inspection confirms 2.1 shell dependency is satisfied — ContentEditorPage.tsx and DocumentFields.tsx both exist in frontend/src/. ProvenancePanel.tsx does not yet exist; MemorySignalChip.tsx exists and can be reused for memory strength display. editor-types.ts needs a ProvenanceData interface added. P1B (graph memory) is status: ready (not done), but is not a hard blocker: the entire editor layer uses mock data (MOCK_DOCUMENT pattern), and acceptance tests require only UI rendering of provenance fields, not a live graph API. Work is bounded to 2 files. Points: 1sp. DoD: (1) frontend/src/components/editor/ProvenancePanel.tsx created and renders Sources, Agent, Corrections, Memory Node sections with mock data; (2) Expand in Memory link navigates to /workbench/memory; (3) Component mounted in ContentEditorPage aside sidebar next to DocumentFields; (4) pnpm typecheck passes in frontend/; (5) pnpm test passes in frontend/. Verdict: ready — all 4 gate checks pass: 1sp ≤5sp, DoD is concrete (named files + CLI commands), no hard inter-task dependency blocking (2.1 done, P1B UI-only mock acceptable), zero ambiguity on exit signal. --tasks-dir orgs/open-hax/openplanner/packages/agents/knoxx/kanban
